review.reviewer: Codex (AI), distinct same-agent evidence and wording review; no independent human or second-agent review claimed
review.notes: Reviewed all 240 exact question propositions against the source-backed axis briefs, counter-evidence and the source register in a distinct pass after authoring. All 240 are disclosed educated assumptions, including institution-to-normative-question translations; exact IDs and per-question dispositions are in the separate review JSON. Rechecked permanent versus temporary immigration, finance versus ownership, clinical versus enhancement biotechnology, national versus regional powers and law versus practice. Changed responses where literal scope or confidence warranted it; did not tune scores or use neighbouring answers. Culture vs Nature relies on contextual child-development and equality evidence, not adopted government heredity positions or religious/traditionalist stereotypes. Neutral answers denote competing implemented elements, not an automatic answer for uncertainty. Historical consolidated constitutions are baselines checked against period reports; Freedom House 2025 describes 2024 background and 2026 describes 2025. Official budgets, reform proposals and IMF recommendations are distinguished from implemented measures. The assessment is a best-effort interpretation with substantial evidence limitations; structural validation cannot certify substantive accuracy. See separate review for warning dispositions and calculated neighbours.
